    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    used_fraction = 1.0 - (bins / max_cap)
    scores[valid] = -np.power(rem[valid], 1.5) + (used_fraction[valid] * 0.5)
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[first_empty] = -max_cap * 2.0
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    fill_ratio = item / bins
    scores[valid] = -np.exp(rem[valid] / max_cap) + 0.5 * np.where(bins[valid] == max_cap, 1.0 - fill_ratio[valid], 0.0)
    return scores

    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    norm_rem = rem[valid] / max_cap
    scores[valid] = -np.tan(np.pi * 0.49 * norm_rem)
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(is_empty):
        first_empty_idx = np.where(is_empty)[0][0]
        scores[first_empty_idx] = -1.5
    return scores
